_comment: DUO-3222/DUO-3227: the ONE project-level WordPress/PHP/database compatibility statement. PHP and database use min-inclusive/max-exclusive ranges; WordPress is the one exact exercised version because no multi-version core matrix exists. The agent pre-policy gate and duo doctor block outside these values, and tools/capability-doc.php cross-checks this file against manifests/capabilities/platform.json so the two copies cannot drift -- never independently-maintained numbers.

php.note: Pinned by the sandbox harness's own Docker tags (wordpress:7.0.3-php8.3-apache / wordpress:cli-php8.3 -- see sandbox/pair.yml, sandbox/db.yml, sandbox/docker-compose.yml). Verified live: PHP 8.3.33 as of this writing.

database.note: Pinned by the sandbox harness's own Docker tag (mariadb:11 -- see sandbox/db.yml, sandbox/docker-compose.yml). Verified live: 11.8.8-MariaDB as of this writing. MySQL is not claimed or tested against; a site running MySQL instead of MariaDB is genuinely untested, not merely unpinned.

wordpress.note: Pinned by the sandbox harness's exact Docker tag (wordpress:7.0.3-php8.3-apache in sandbox/pair.yml). WordPress is one exact exercised value, not a claimed range: the agent pre-policy gate and duo doctor refuse any other core version before mutation. A wider claim requires a real multi-version core matrix.
